title: Dropdown
description: Opens with a soft scale. Headings, dividers and a red danger item included.
usage: Group actions under one trigger. Keep destructive actions last, below a divider, in red.
a11y: Closes on outside click and on Escape. While closed, the menu is hidden from Tab and assistive tech after its fade-out. Not yet implemented: returning focus to the trigger on close, aria-expanded on the trigger, and arrow-key movement between items; the T4 Stable pass covers them.
